desc: Implement exact-v2 residue bucketing: for each k with 2^k <= 2*max(A), build per-residue count maps for modulus 2^(k+1); accumulate ordered pair contributions via target residue (2^k - A_i) mod 2^(k+1).
Deduplicate values with Counter and use array-vs-dict strategy for residue counting to keep total cost O(N log maxA).
Compute diagonal contribution as sum of odd parts of A_i and output (ordered_total + diag)//2.
Validate on samples 1-3 (all PASSED) and edge cases N=1, duplicates, max values.
